## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: When this story is complete, review-findings-schema.md or the relevant contracts doc reflects that the ±5-line proximity window is now enforced by runner.py _suppress_defended_findings (not just defined in schema)
- DD3: When this story is complete, the relation field documentation indicates that runner.py validates relation + escape_rationale for cycle ≥ 2 NEW_INTRODUCED findings (activated by Story B)
- DD4: When this story is complete, no reference doc still describes the proximity matching or relation enforcement as future/planned behavior

## Implementation Notes

File: plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-findings-schema.md

### Change 1 — escape_rationale Format section (proximity enforcement)

In the `escape_rationale Format` section (around lines 200–219), add a runtime enforcement note immediately after the structural validity requirement paragraph (the one ending "...not by LLM judgment."):

> **Runtime enforcement (active since Story A — 1ef8-79c4)**: `runner.py _suppress_defended_findings` now evaluates proximity overlap at review-cycle time. When a `NEW_INTRODUCED` finding's `cited_lines` fall within the ±5-line proximity window of a prior defended finding's `cited_lines`, the finding is suppressed unless a valid `escape_rationale` is provided. This is enforced unconditionally on every cycle-N+1 run — it is not a schema hint.

### Change 2 — Relation Enum section (novelty gate runtime enforcement)

In the `Relation Enum` section (after the Validity rules table), add a new subsection:

> ### Runtime Enforcement of NEW_INTRODUCED Validation
>
> As of Story B (0b1b-8177), `runner.py _apply_novelty_gate` validates `relation` and `escape_rationale` for `NEW_INTRODUCED` findings on cycle ≥ 2:
>
> - A `NEW_INTRODUCED` finding on cycle ≥ 2 whose `cited_lines` overlap (±5 lines) with a prior defended finding is suppressed unless a structurally valid `escape_rationale` is provided.
> - An `escape_rationale` must satisfy all three criteria (present in diff context, not in prior cited lines, not in proximity overlap region) or it is rejected and the finding is treated as defended.
> - This validation runs in `runner.py` independently of `prior_defenses` availability — it executes even when the prior defense list is empty.

### Change 3 — Language audit

Scan the document for any remaining language that describes proximity matching or relation enforcement as "future", "planned", "defined but not enforced", "will be enforced", or similar. Remove or update such language.

### Change 4 — Change Log

Append to the `### Change Log` section at the bottom:
- **2026-05-15**: Added runtime enforcement notes for ±5-line proximity matching (now enforced by `runner.py _suppress_defended_findings`, Story A 1ef8-79c4) and for `NEW_INTRODUCED` relation + escape_rationale validation (now enforced by `runner.py _apply_novelty_gate`, Story B 0b1b-8177).

## TDD Requirement

test-exempt: static assets only (non-executable .md instruction/contract file — Rule 5 of behavioral-testing-standard.md). No behavioral assertions are possible for doc content. Verification is structural: confirm the target strings are present in the modified file.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint 2>/dev/null || echo "ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py") && $LINT_CMD

- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check 2>/dev/null || echo "ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py") && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD

- [ ] review-findings-schema.md exists at expected path
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-findings-schema.md

- [ ] Proximity runtime enforcement note is present (references runner.py _suppress_defended_findings)
  Verify: grep -q "_suppress_defended_findings" plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-findings-schema.md

- [ ] Novelty gate runtime note is present (references _apply_novelty_gate and cycle >= 2)
  Verify: grep -q "_apply_novelty_gate" plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-findings-schema.md

- [ ] No "planned" or "future" proximity/relation enforcement language remains
  Verify: ! grep -iE "(planned|future|will be enforced|not yet enforced)" plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-findings-schema.md

- [ ] Change Log entry for 2026-05-15 is present
  Verify: grep -q "2026-05-15" plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-findings-schema.md
data.title: Update review-findings-schema.md: proximity enforcement + novelty gate runtime activation notes
